Trajectory-level density map (time-series space)

One point is one entire trial. Coordinates are the UMAP of this signal’s PCA scores (Berman et al. 2014 Figs 4 and 7). Color is local density or nearest-neighbor rarity in the original time-series distance space of the active signal. The field is a 48×48 Gaussian-smoothed PDF (σ=1.6). HDBSCAN is the watershed analogue of Fig 7.

How often each cluster occurs across mice and sessions

After clusters are identified for the active signal: trial mass, share of mice that visit a mode, share of sessions that visit it, then occupancy heatmaps. Analogue of Berman Figs 8b and 9. U = unclustered.

Grouped bars: % mice visiting · % sessions visiting · % of trials (mass).

Every trial in every cluster, including unclustered. Each line is one trial and stops when that trial ends — no padded zeros. Axes are fixed: time 0–2.56 s from stimOn, y 0 to the signal maximum.
